GitHub

command reference

devopsgen validate

Statically lint DevOpsGen output — Dockerfiles, GitHub Actions workflows and Kubernetes manifests — so problems surface on your laptop instead of pipeline number forty.

synopsis
devopsgen validate [flags]          # validate the current project
devopsgen validate --output-dir ./configs

What it checks

Docker

  • FROM base images are pinned to digest form
  • Required install/prune steps match the package manager
  • Non-root user declared

GitHub Actions

  • Workflow documents carry required structure and names
  • Actions are pinned, config files complete
  • Checkout steps reference valid refs

Kubernetes

  • Resources are DNS 1123/1035 rename-clean
  • Service ↔ Ingress wiring is consistent
  • Probe/health requirements satisfied

Exit behaviour

  • 0 — all documents passed.
  • 4 — at least one document failed validation.
  • 2 — malformed input (unreadable paths, invalid flags).

Combine with devopsgen init in CI: generate, commit, validate, deploy — the exit codes page maps every failure class.
